title: Apple Silicon Thermals
stale: Sensor readings expired. Manual controls are disabled until fresh data arrives.
writeFailed: Could not change fan control. The safety service will attempt automatic recovery.
writeTimeout: Fan command timed out. The manual lease will expire automatically.
heartbeatFailed: Manual cooling lease could not be renewed. The safety service will attempt automatic recovery.
unsupported: This widget requires Apple Silicon hardware running Linux.
driverMissing: The macsmc_hwmon driver is unavailable. This does not mean this Mac is fanless.
sensorNote: These sensors do not measure CPU or GPU die temperature.
setup: Monitoring only. Install the optional safety service to enable temporary manual cooling.
leaseNote: Manual speeds are temporary. If this widget stops renewing its lease, the safety service attempts to return cooling to firmware control.
